Class CardArtManifest

java.lang.Object
mesos.client.ui.resource.CardArtManifest
public final class CardArtManifest extends Object
Maps a model card name (e.g. "Hunter-I-3", "Sustenance Artists", "FinalEvent-1") to a 1-based page index inside Cards_total_front_NO PROMO.pdf (the 122-card print sheet).

Strategy:

  • Characters (Hunter/Shaman/Artist/Builder/Inventor/Gatherer): loaded from character-manifest.properties which maps each of the 84 character pages to an exact (TYPE, ERA) pair. A query for (HUNTER, I) cycles deterministically through the matching pages so Hunter-I-0 .. Hunter-I-4 each land on a different Hunter Era-I print.
  • Events (Hunting/Shamanic/Cave/Sustenance): the next 10 pages (85-94) — each event type maps to a band of pages.
  • Buildings: 21 named cards mapped explicitly to pages 95-115, in the order produced by BuildingDeckFactory.
  • Final Events: pages 116-117.
  • Anything else: deterministic hash over the full 1..122 range.

Era-boundary note: the PDF lays out characters as:

  • Era I : pages 1-29 (HUNTER 1-5, INVENTOR 6-9, GATHERER 10-13, SHAMAN 14-18, ARTIST 19-25, BUILDER 26-29)
  • Era II : pages 30-57 (same type order)
  • Era III: pages 58-84 (same type order)

  • Method Details

    • pageForName

      public static int pageForName(String name)
      Returns the 1-based PDF page index for the given model card name.

      Character names must follow the pattern TYPE-ERA-copyIndex, e.g. "Hunter-I-0", "Shaman-III-2".

    • pageForCharacter

      public static int pageForCharacter(String typeKey, String eraKey, int copyIndex)
      Returns the PDF page for a character identified by type key, era key, and a zero-based copy index (cycles through all matching pages).
      Parameters:
      typeKey - e.g. "HUNTER", "SHAMAN" (upper-case)
      eraKey - "I", "II", or "III"
      copyIndex - zero-based copy index; cycles modulo the page count
      Returns:
      1-based page number, or -1 if the manifest has no entry

    • pagesForTypeEra

      public static List<Integer> pagesForTypeEra(String typeKey, String eraKey)
      Returns all PDF pages classified as the given (type, era) pair. Returns an empty list if the manifest has no matching entry.
